evidence.summary: SASTIND and the Ministry of Education named Tsinghua University in 2016 as one of 16 universities they co-build for 2016–2020, to support defence-specialty disciplines and majors, defence key discipline laboratories and training for the defence industry.

CASI identifies Tsinghua University, with the nuclear group CNNC’s Research Institute of Physical and Chemical Engineering, as host of the national defence science and technology key laboratory for particle transport and enrichment technology, which it links to nuclear weapons and power; it also names Tsinghua as a possible partner in the human factors engineering laboratory of the PLA’s astronaut research and training centre.
